text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... What a pretty clover. Looking at 
it makes me feel so at peace...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to be discouraged by 
something like this, so why are my 
legs...?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Still... if I ruin my health, it defeats 
the whole purpose, right? After all, it's 
not just my problem alone...”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let us retire to the dorms early 
today. One must rest their body as much as 
possible during leisure time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion seems quite exhausted. I might 
need to reconsider her race schedule.
